title: Natural global sections and Galois invariants for an abelian stalk equivalence
statement: Let K be a field, Ks a separable closure, and Omega an algebraically closed extension containing Ks over K. Let T be a terminal object of the small etale site of Spec K, E an equivalence from abelian sheaves valued in universe u+1 to discrete continuous integer representations of Gal(Ks/K), and i a natural additive isomorphism from its underlying groups to the geometric stalk at Spec Omega. Assume that i intertwines the E action with transport of germs through every automorphism of Omega extending an element of Gal(Ks/K). There are additive equivalences t_F from F(T) to the invariant subgroups of E(F), natural in F: for every sheaf morphism phi, t sends phi(T) to the underlying map E(phi).

proof.text: Under the geometric stalk equivalence of sheaves of sets and Galois sets, Yoneda identifies sections over the terminal representable sheaf with equivariant maps from its singleton stalk. Such maps are precisely the invariant stalk elements. The supplied action formula identifies this canonical action with that of E; extensions of every Galois automorphism exist and all germs have representatives.

The germ maps are additive. Thus the functorial bijection of Tag 04JM is an additive equivalence. Naturality of i and of germ maps gives the displayed equality for each sheaf morphism. Alternatively, the direct proof in the docstring uses representatives over finite Galois neighbourhoods, injective restriction, and finite Galois descent.
